name: 112A - API - Manage Channel Gateway Clients - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS action,
        $2::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        NULLIF($3::BIGINT, 0) AS gateway_client_id,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT, '') AS client_name,
        NULLIF($5::TEXT, '') AS channel,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS provider_name,
        $7::TEXT AS auth_mode,
        NULLIF($8::TEXT, '') AS api_key,
        NULLIF($9::TEXT, '') AS signature_verifier_url,
        NULLIF($10::TEXT, '') AS signature_credential_reference,
        $11::JSONB AS allowed_ip_addresses_json,
        $12::INTEGER AS rate_limit_requests,
        $13::INTEGER AS rate_limit_window_seconds,
        $14::INTEGER AS replay_window_seconds,
        $15::JSONB AS metadata,
        NULLIF($16::TEXT, '') AS actor_name,
        $17::INTEGER AS result_limit
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        request.action,
        request.gateway_client_id,
        request.client_name,
        request.channel,
        request.provider_name,
        request.auth_mode,
        request.api_key,
        request.signature_verifier_url,
        request.signature_credential_reference,
        ARRAY(
            SELECT JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(
                request.allowed_ip_addresses_json
            )
        ) AS allowed_ip_addresses,
        request.rate_limit_requests,
        request.rate_limit_window_seconds,
        request.replay_window_seconds,
        request.metadata,
        request.actor_name,
        request.result_limit
    FROM request_data request
    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
    LIMIT 1
),

target_client AS (
    SELECT client.*
    FROM channel_gateway_clients client
    INNER JOIN clinic_context context
        ON client.clinic_id =
           context.clinic_id
    WHERE (
            context.gateway_client_id IS NOT NULL
            AND client.id =
                context.gateway_client_id
          )
       OR (
            context.gateway_client_id IS NULL
            AND context.client_name IS NOT NULL
            AND client.client_name =
                context.client_name
            AND (
                  context.channel IS NULL
                  OR client.channel =
                     context.channel
                )
          )
    ORDER BY client.id
    LIMIT 1
),

inserted_client AS (
    INSERT INTO channel_gateway_clients (
        clinic_id,
        client_name,
        channel,
        provider_name,
        auth_mode,
        api_key_hash,
        signature_verifier_url,
        signature_credential_reference,
        allowed_ip_addresses,
        rate_limit_requests,
        rate_limit_window_seconds,
        replay_window_seconds,
        enabled,
        metadata,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.client_name,
        context.channel,
        context.provider_name,
        context.auth_mode,
        CASE
            WHEN context.api_key IS NOT NULL
                THEN ENCODE(
                    DIGEST(
                        context.api_key,
                        'sha256'
                    ),
                    'hex'
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        context.signature_verifier_url,
        context.signature_credential_reference,
        context.allowed_ip_addresses,
        context.rate_limit_requests,
        context.rate_limit_window_seconds,
        context.replay_window_seconds,
        FALSE,
        context.metadata,
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context context
    WHERE context.action = 'create'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_client
          )
    RETURNING *
),

updated_client AS (
    UPDATE channel_gateway_clients client
    SET
        client_name = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
             AND context.client_name IS NOT NULL
                THEN context.client_name
            ELSE client.client_name
        END,

        channel = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
             AND context.channel IS NOT NULL
                THEN context.channel
            ELSE client.channel
        END,

        provider_name = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
                THEN COALESCE(
                    context.provider_name,
                    client.provider_name
                )
            ELSE client.provider_name
        END,

        auth_mode = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
                THEN context.auth_mode
            ELSE client.auth_mode
        END,

        api_key_hash = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'rotate_api_key'
                THEN ENCODE(
                    DIGEST(
                        context.api_key,
                        'sha256'
                    ),
                    'hex'
                )
            ELSE client.api_key_hash
        END,

        signature_verifier_url = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
                THEN COALESCE(
                    context.signature_verifier_url,
                    client.signature_verifier_url
                )
            ELSE client.signature_verifier_url
        END,

        signature_credential_reference = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
                THEN COALESCE(
                    context.signature_credential_reference,
                    client.signature_credential_reference
                )
            ELSE client.signature_credential_reference
        END,

        allowed_ip_addresses = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
                THEN context.allowed_ip_addresses
            ELSE client.allowed_ip_addresses
        END,

        rate_limit_requests = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
                THEN context.rate_limit_requests
            ELSE client.rate_limit_requests
        END,

        rate_limit_window_seconds = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
                THEN context.rate_limit_window_seconds
            ELSE client.rate_limit_window_seconds
        END,

        replay_window_seconds = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
                THEN context.replay_window_seconds
            ELSE client.replay_window_seconds
        END,

        enabled = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'activate'
                THEN TRUE
            WHEN context.action = 'deactivate'
                THEN FALSE
            ELSE client.enabled
        END,

        metadata = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'update'
                THEN client.metadata ||
                     context.metadata
            ELSE client.metadata
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM clinic_context context
    WHERE client.id = (
            SELECT id
            FROM target_client
          )
      AND context.action IN (
            'update',
            'rotate_api_key',
            'activate',
            'deactivate'
          )
    RETURNING client.*
),

effective_client AS (
    SELECT inserted.*
    FROM inserted_client inserted

    UNION ALL

    SELECT updated.*
    FROM updated_client updated

    UNION ALL

    SELECT target.*
    FROM target_client target
    CROSS JOIN clinic_context context
    WHERE context.action = 'get'

    LIMIT 1
),

listed_clients AS (
    SELECT
        client.id,
        client.clinic_id,
        client.client_name,
        client.channel,
        client.provider_name,
        client.auth_mode,
        client.signature_verifier_url,
        client.signature_credential_reference,
        client.allowed_ip_addresses,
        client.rate_limit_requests,
        client.rate_limit_window_seconds,
        client.replay_window_seconds,
        client.enabled,
        client.metadata,
        client.created_at,
        client.updated_at,

        CASE
            WHEN client.api_key_hash IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS api_key_configured

    FROM channel_gateway_clients client
    INNER JOIN clinic_context context
        ON client.clinic_id =
           context.clinic_id
    WHERE context.action = 'list'
    ORDER BY
        client.channel,
        client.client_name,
        client.id
    LIMIT (
        SELECT result_limit
        FROM clinic_context
    )
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN context.action = 'create'
         AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_client
         )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN context.action IN (
            'update',
            'rotate_api_key',
            'activate',
            'deactivate',
            'get'
        )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_client
         )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'

        WHEN context.action = 'create'
         AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_client
         )
            THEN 'gateway_client_already_exists'

        WHEN context.action IN (
            'update',
            'rotate_api_key',
            'activate',
            'deactivate',
            'get'
        )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_client
         )
            THEN 'gateway_client_not_found'

        WHEN context.action = 'create'
            THEN 'gateway_client_created'

        WHEN context.action = 'update'
            THEN 'gateway_client_updated'

        WHEN context.action = 'rotate_api_key'
            THEN 'gateway_client_api_key_rotated'

        WHEN context.action = 'activate'
            THEN 'gateway_client_activated'

        WHEN context.action = 'deactivate'
            THEN 'gateway_client_deactivated'

        WHEN context.action = 'get'
            THEN 'gateway_client_loaded'

        ELSE 'gateway_clients_listed'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'id',
                effective.id,
            'clinic_id',
                effective.clinic_id,
            'client_name',
                effective.client_name,
            'channel',
                effective.channel,
            'provider_name',
                effective.provider_name,
            'auth_mode',
                effective.auth_mode,
            'signature_verifier_url',
                effective.signature_verifier_url,
            'signature_credential_reference',
                effective.signature_credential_reference,
            'allowed_ip_addresses',
                effective.allowed_ip_addresses,
            'rate_limit_requests',
                effective.rate_limit_requests,
            'rate_limit_window_seconds',
                effective.rate_limit_window_seconds,
            'replay_window_seconds',
                effective.replay_window_seconds,
            'enabled',
                effective.enabled,
            'metadata',
                effective.metadata,
            'api_key_configured',
                effective.api_key_hash IS NOT NULL
        )
        FROM effective_client effective
    ) AS gateway_client,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(listed)
            )
            FROM listed_clients listed
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS gateway_clients

FROM clinic_context context

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE,
    'clinic_not_found',
    NULL::JSONB,
    '[]'::JSONB

FROM request_data request
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM clinic_context
);

parameters.content:
## مدیریت Gateway Client

اقدام‌ها:
- create
- update
- rotate_api_key
- activate
- deactivate
- get
- list

Client جدید همیشه غیرفعال ساخته می‌شود و بعد از بررسی باید Activate شود.

API Key خام هرگز در خروجی برگردانده نمی‌شود.
